_comment: Jin's servants — the 10 labelled enemies. `cell` is the 0-based column on the shared 10-wide sheet (assets/story/enemies_and_bosses.png, sliced via AtlasTexture, source PNG untouched) — still used by the 6 enemies with no dedicated `art` id. `tier` drives base HP + how much match energy is needed to defeat one. Each island has a roster (which enemies appear on its stages) and a boss stage (every 10th). Stage 50's boss is Jinn himself (assets/story/jinn_portrait.png, unchanged — a named, already-established character, never swapped). Rewards + progression use the existing Economy/Progress/Boosters — nothing new here.
_comment_art: 5 enemies got a dedicated single-character piece (assets/story/villains/<id>.png, AssetLibrary story_villain_<id>) instead of a sheet slice, mapped to the closest `aura` colour/theme. `torso_y` is the measured fraction (top of the image = 0, bottom = 1) where that art's actual solid character sits — EnemyActor.configure() reads it instead of a fixed ratio, because these images carry very different amounts of surrounding glow/aura padding than the uniform sheet did (see tools/keyed_sprites/measure_torso.py). Enemies with no `art`/`torso_y` keep the old sheet slice and the 0.44 default, unchanged.
_comment_minor_villain: 2026-09-05 correction: exactly ONE persistent minor villain per island/chapter (all 10 stages, normal AND the boss stage), not a rotating pick — the player fights the same recognizable enemy throughout a chapter. `roster` is kept for roster_for_island()/tests but no longer drives per-stage enemy selection; `minor_villain` does. Islands 0-3 use the same id as their `boss` (the chapter's persistent enemy IS its boss); island 4's boss is Jinn (stage 50 only, final battle), so its minor villain for stages 41-49 is stone_golem — the 5th dedicated-art enemy, otherwise unassigned to a chapter.
